summary.text: Brad Batt is the Democratic candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Tim Hicks and independent Rodger Broadwater.
Batt is an entrepreneur who earned a bachelor's degree from Louisiana Tech University in 1995 and a graduate degree from Regis University in 2003.

paragraphs.text: Brad Batt's career experience includes working as an entrepreneur, according to Ballotpedia.
He ran for Tennessee House District 6 as the Democratic nominee in 2020 and 2024 and lost both general elections to Tim Hicks.
Batt advanced from the Democratic primary again on August 6, 2026.
